run_f_gold: run the gnome sort algorithm on an array of n elements and return the sorted array
test_f_gold: test the gnome sort implementation against multiple test cases with expected sorted output
refactor_f_gold: refactor the gnome sort function to support descending order or custom comparators
review_f_gold: review the gnome sort algorithm for correctness and edge case handling
summarize_f_gold: summarize the gnome sort algorithm which swaps adjacent out-of-order elements repeatedly
